title: Relics armoury
hook: **WIP:** one vault of gear — find, equip, compare, salvage. Opens as a chapter in the Vision unlock ladder (proposed Dave 10).

blindSpots.meaning: Gear in your vault — not lawn plant food.
The one player vault fantasy for the item loop.
Older storage pages may exist; treat them as scaffolding, not the finished armoury.
Before the item chapter opens, drops should not leave you staring at useless loot chrome.

sections.title: Fantasy
paras: Find gear, vault it, equip, compare, salvage what you do not need.

sections.title: In this build
paras: Full armoury loop is not finished.
Relics layer unlocks on the live beat when you hold your first item — still not the finished chapter fantasy.

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP
doSteps: If Relics unlocks, open `R` and learn what thin UI exists.
Do not expect finished craft/compare loops yet.
Keep playing power and roster loops.

mixUps.a: WIP — thin surfaces may appear; fantasy vault is unfinished.
Dave chapters are Vision; live unlock is first item held.

mixUps.q: Is this the same as aptitudes?

mixUps.a: When salvage exists, junk has a sink; until then do not invent a hoarding rule.
